title: Very Thick Pillow
text: Very Thick Pillow. No matter how I shaped this pillow it was always too thick to be comfortable in my bed. I like a very thin pillow. The one I have is 20+ years old and flat as a pancake. All these pillows today are crazy thick and put a lot of painful pressure on my neck. I didn't enjoy using this pillow.
